# OpenAPI contract surface snapshot (Milestone 7.6).
#
# Pins the two systemic guarantees the hardening milestone owns:
#   1. required vs optional members and operation parameters, derived from C# nullability;
#   2. named string enums, never bare numeric enum values;
# and the M7.6 follow-up Phase 4 guarantees (Shared M2 H3/H4):
#   3. response numbers typed number/integer only, request numbers still accepting strings;
#   4. each operation's own token requirement (security none | IdentityBearer | BranchBearer[roles]).
#
# Generated by OpenApiContractSurface.Render from the live /openapi/v1.json document.
# Environment-dependent and generator-noise fields (servers, info, descriptions, examples,
# formats, patterns, duplicate media types) are excluded, and every list is ordinally sorted.
# A trailing '?' marks a schema that also accepts null.
#
# Regenerate: run OpenApiContractSurfaceSnapshotTest, review the emitted
# openapi-contract-surface.received.txt diff, then replace this file with it.

openapi 3.1.1

## security
document-level none
scheme BranchBearer http bearer
scheme IdentityBearer http bearer

## enums
enum AccountType string: Terminal, BankAccount, Tab
enum AgingBucket string: Current, Days0To30, Days31To60, Days61To90, Days91Plus
enum BrazilianHolidayCalendarSource string: Composite, Canonical, BrasilApi, Nager
enum BrazilianHolidayImportStatus string: Imported, Skipped
enum BrazilianHolidayType string: National, OptionalFederal
enum DailyCloseReviewEventType string: Rejected, OpeningChanged
enum DailyCloseStatus string: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Rejected
enum Direction string: In, Out
enum FiadoPaymentKind string: CountedCash, NonCash
enum HolidaySource string: Manual, Canonical, BrasilApi, Nager
enum InstallmentPlanStatus string: Draft, Active, Mixed, Cancelled
enum InvitationStatus string: Pending, Accepted, Declined, Expired
enum MailDeliveryStatus string: Pending, Sent, Failed
enum MonthlyFinancialRole string: None, BolaoServiceFee, CommercialLeftover
enum MonthlyReconciliationBlockerType string: UnapprovedClose, DraftTransactions, MissingExpectedClose
enum OperatorLinkRequestStatus string: Pending, Resolved
enum OverviewSectionStatus string: Ready, Empty, NotConfigured
enum Role string: Admin, Manager, Member
enum SettlementInstrument string: None, Cheque, CreditCard, DebitCard
enum SettlementRule string: SameDay, NextCalendarDay, NextBusinessDay, TwoBusinessDays, OperatorEnteredCheque
enum TimeEntryStatus string: Present, DayOff, Sunday, Holiday, Vacation, JustifiedAbsence, UnjustifiedAbsence
enum TimeEntryTapAction string: Open, Close
enum TransactionGenerationKind string: FiadoCountedStockSale, FiadoCashRepayment
enum TransactionStatus string: Draft, Active, Cancelled
enum TransactionTypeSystemRole string: FiadoCountedStockSaleCounterpart, FiadoCashRepaymentCounterpart
